items.title: 팀원을 만들었는데 말벗이 됐다, 크래프톤 'PUBG Ally' 첫 성적표
items.excerpt: 크래프톤이 'PUBG: 배틀그라운드'의 AI 동료 'PUBG Ally' 개발 과정을 담은 기술보고서를 논문 공개 사이트 아카이브(arXiv)에 올렸다. 55쪽 분량의 보고서에는 아키텍처와 학습 방식이 담겼고, 라이브 베타의 이용자 설문 결과도 실렸다. 설문에서 이용자들은 크래프톤이 내세운 '같이 싸우는 팀원'보다 '정보를 주고 말을 걸어주는 상대'로서의 앨

items.title: Meta unveils AI-powered game tools for mobile devices and browsers; announces VR Glasses with day-one Unity support
items.excerpt: Horizon Centre and Horizon Studio will "make it easier to turn your ideas into playable 2D and 3D games"

items.title: Injecting DLSS 5 Into The Witcher 3 Remastered Gives Geralt a Much-Needed Facelift, but Costs Up to 30% Performance
items.excerpt: We've hooked NVIDIA DLSS 5 into The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered with intriguing results, both in visuals and performance.

items.title: SecretSauce Labs' Simon Davis on leaving games behind and solving AI's brand consistency problem
items.excerpt: Wearemighty is leaving game development behind and rebranding as SecretSauce Labs, shifting its focus entirely to AI content technology

items.title: Tokyo Game Show 2026 celebrated the past, and an uncertain AI future | Opinion
items.excerpt: The event's 30th instalment was dominated by remakes and legacy IP, and suggested a future shaped by AI and transmedia

items.title: Microsoft file patent for a machine learning system that would "train" itself on your playtime to work out when you'll be least annoyed by in-game ads
items.excerpt: Microsoft file patent for in-game ad system that could use machine learning and player credits to avoid, or gamify the avoiding of a "negative use experience".

items.title: Insomniac denies AI made Marvel's Wolverine's weird bathroom sign - blames a "UV map bug" instead
items.excerpt: Insomniac denies using generative AI on Marvel's Wolverine after fans spotted a strange bathroom sign, blaming a "UV map bug" instead.

items.title: MiHoYo wins $112,000 in Genshin Impact AI voice cloning lawsuit
items.excerpt: A Shanghai, China-based court ruled that a genAI voice synthesizer developer infringed on MiHoYo's copyright on Genshin Impact.

items.title: Dueling industry surveys show Japanese game devs are embracing AI, while North American ones are still skeptical
items.excerpt: Two industry surveys point in opposite directions: Japan's CESA finds 85.8% of Japanese game developers use generative AI at work, while North American developers remain markedly more skeptical.

items.title: 'Frame-by-frame' AI-generated global illumination could be part of AMD's answer to DLSS 5 someday
items.excerpt: AMD researchers presented a technique that hands indirect lighting (global illumination) to an image-generation model frame by frame, an approach PC Gamer frames as a possible future answer to Nvidia's DLSS 5 neural rendering.

items.title: Team Behind Popular Ocarina Of Time  PC Port Admit To Using AI For Years And Now Fans Are Freaking Out About 'Vibecoded Slop' - Kotaku
items.excerpt: When asked what version of Ship of Harkinian doesn't contain LLM content, a dev said 'I don't know'

items.title: Level-5 Announces Fixes For AI-Generated Presentation
items.excerpt: According to Level-5, many of the perceived 'AI slop' elements in its recent presentation were due to the rushed nature of the Nintendo Direct, and were not AI-generated

items.title: PS5 Linux dev abandons the project as AI "slop kiddies" ruin open-source mods ahead of GTA 6: "Just a bunch of noobs using LLMs and writing hacks they don't even understand"
items.excerpt: A PS5 Linux developer has abandoned the project, blaming inexperienced modders who use LLMs to generate code they don't understand for degrading the open-source modding scene ahead of GTA 6.

items.title: Unity's Official Plugin for Codex: Skills, CLI, Editor Control
items.excerpt: Unity's official plugin for Codex is an official plugin that gives OpenAI's Codex Unity-written skills, so the agent works from Unity's own guidance for jobs like sprite atlases, URP renderer features, in-app purchases, and localization instead of from whatever it absorbed about Unity elsewhere.

items.title: Your guide to the official Unity plugin for Claude Code
items.excerpt: Unity walks through installing its official plugin for Claude Code, the pipeline architecture, and a live demo in which Claude Code reads and drives the Unity Editor at runtime for prototyping gameplay and managing scenes.
